messages:
alex-sales: Quick sync on FoxPoint POC. They said they'll only issue a PO after Order Form + MSA/DPA redlines are agreed. Need to confirm blocking items from Legal + KMS details for Private.

olivia-legal: Key redlines: (A) Liability cap request (they want 3x fees) -- we should offer 'greater of $250k or prior 12 months fees'. (B) DPA: they want data residency + subprocessors control. We can accept Appendix A with an updatable list and 30d notice. If they insist on 3x cap escalate to VP Legal.

ben-ps: Pricing: quote_v4 has Net30 and Net45 columns (link: https://redwood.example/quote/FP-2345/v4). Net30 is our preferred finance term; Net45 ok with small surcharge. Also note Dedicated commit reduces unit price but needs 60d provisioning notice.

maya-cs: Security asks: SOC2 Type II under NDA (we can share), and SAML SSO setup -- estimate ~10 business days for POC integration once they provide IdP metadata.

ciara-ops: KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys for Private. I'll drop a KMS attestation + rotation policy + minimal onboarding checklist here by EOD. HSM-backed provisioning lead time ~7 business days post-signature.

alex-sales: Olivia, can you paste the exact proposed redline text for the liability cap and DPA appendix so I can send it to their procurement? Need to know if Exec sign-off might be required before Friday.

olivia-legal: Proposed liability clause: "Supplier's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of $250,000 or the fees paid by Customer to Supplier under the Order Form in the 12 months preceding the claim." DPA addendum: Appendix A maintained by Supplier; new subprocessors notified 30 days in advance. If counterparty continues to insist on 3x, escalate -- VP Legal/GC review ETA ~48hrs.

ben-ps: Signing order suggestion: procurement@foxpoint.com -> legal@foxpoint.com -> alex-sales@redwood.com -> finance@redwood.com. Include a PO_NUMBER field on the Order Form and mark it required if they confirm they'll send a PO.

signing-bot: DocuSign envelope checklist: signing_order present, PO_NUMBER field present. Set signing_order as provided by sales.

alex-sales: I'll send redlines + quote_v4 with Net30/Net45 options and the proposed signing order. Mia (procurement contact) prefers Procurement first. Will create DocuSign envelope once they confirm emails.

maya-cs: I'll DM their security lead for SOC2 NDA and kick off SAML scheduling.

ciara-ops: Uploaded KMS attestation: https://secure.redwood/shares/foxpoint-kms-attest ; rotation policy + terraform snippet included.

alex-sales: Perfect. Any other payment or compliance blockers? If not, I'll move this to outreach and update thread.

olivia-legal: None from Legal aside from the noted cap/subprocessor points. :white_check_mark:
